verdict.rationale: Cekura has its own programmatic surface: a published OpenAPI spec, API reference endpoints (sending calls, creating API keys), a CLI that manages agents, scenarios, runs and call data, and sync/async SDK clients. Nothing documents full UI parity, though, and some workflows (A/B comparison on the Results page, dashboard building) are only described as UI actions. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, documented API coverage for dashboards, A/B comparison, PII redaction and cron configuration, and independent hands-on corroboration of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
